call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: One finished flat Korean typographic poster, portrait 2:3, opaque pure white background.

Original user request (production instructions, not extra display copy): 덕테이프 포스터로 '숨과 숨 사이'를 5장 만들어줘. 검은 글자와 흰 여백만 써줘. 문구는 한 번만 넣고, 그림·도형·테두리·구분선·질감·장식 기호·추가 문구는 넣지 마. 줄바꿈은 어절 사이에서만 해도 좋아.
You are producing ONE assigned poster from the centrally managed five. Do not show five panels, variants, numbers or style labels.

Exact complete visible copy, once only: 숨과 숨 사이
Use the two-line reading order:
숨과 숨
사이
The wide space between the first-line words is a typographic word-space, not additional characters. Preserve every syllable and intact Korean glyph structure. Do not add quotation marks. The original phrase contains two occurrences of 숨: render exactly these two, with 과 attached to the first and 사이 following below. No other text.

Assigned direction: 같은 줄의 두 '숨'이 만든 간격을 아래의 '사이'가 시각적으로 받아 준다. 가까운 방향과 구분할 관계: 첫 두 어절을 한 줄의 동등한 관계로 먼저 읽는다. 첫 '숨과'를 독립된 시작으로 떼어내지 않고 두 첫 어절이 한 줄을 공유해야 한다.

Concrete composition: First sight is the two equally weighted occurrences of 숨 across the shared first-line baseline. Render 숨과 as a compact intact word on the left and 숨 as an intact word on the right, same font size, same weight, same baseline. Use clean robust Korean sans-serif lettering with open internal counters, moderate stroke weight, no horizontal compression, no decorative deformation. Top line occupies about 73 percent of page width, vertically near 43 percent of the page. The left word and right word are separated by a substantial quiet white interval, roughly one and a half glyph widths. The lower word 사이 sits directly below this interval, optically centered on the interval itself, at about 62 percent of the top-line font size. Its letters remain normally spaced as one word. Give the two lines enough white vertical separation that no strokes nearly touch. Use the lower word to name the space between the two breaths: its whole horizontal extent should fit comfortably within that white interval. Large white margins around this single typographic relationship, no additional visual elements. Reading path: left word 숨과, right word 숨, then the smaller centered 사이 below the gap. Keep all text well within frame.

Mandatory conditions:
1. Black lettering and a flat solid white background only. No gray fills, colored pixels as design elements, lighting, gradients, photographs, paper surface or texture. Natural edge antialiasing is acceptable.
2. Render the one original string exactly once. The two source occurrences of 숨 must both remain.
3. No illustration, icon, shape, border, divider line, texture, ornament, decorative punctuation, logo, watermark, extra copy or fake small text.
4. Line breaks only between whole words. No breaking Korean syllables or disassembling glyphs into pictures.
5. Portrait 2:3. A single flat full-page poster, not a physical mockup, framed object or contact sheet.
